image_sidecars.justification: PNG colormap (viridis) heatmaps keyed by (jurisdiction, period_id); 100% coverage in train and pred; planned for colormap-inversion scalar summary extraction.

image_features.colormap_inversion_detail: Build 256-entry RGB LUT for the colormap named in file_sidecars[0].colormap (viridis); map each pixel to nearest LUT index to recover scalar in [0,1]; mask background pixels where nearest-LUT distance exceeds threshold.
image_features.leakage_note: Images are static per (jurisdiction, period_id) — not target-derived; scalar summaries extracted once per unique image; SVD fit on fold-train unique images only for reproducibility. If images are jurisdction-level trend signals, the Step-6A ablation gate decides whether they earn their columns.

feature_plan.rationale: Comprehensive: all covariates used, text SVD extracted, period ordinal and seasonality derived, lag 1/3/6/12 supported by autocorrelation (0.42-0.56) and 77-period length, image scalar summaries from viridis inversion. Overfit-guarded: target-enc and aggregates per fold, image SVD and rolling-std flagged experimental for Step-6A ablation, raw period_id/jurisdiction strings excluded.

completeness_constraints.submission_frame_expansion: data/val/covariates.csv has 357 rows (7 periods x 51 jurisdictions). sample_submission.csv has 918 rows = 6 periods x 51 jurisdictions x 3 scoring categories (all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants). The 7th pred period (if5b8Sut) appears in covariates but may not appear in the submission; submission frame is the authoritative output roster. Expand predictions by joining prediction covariates to the (period_id, jurisdiction, overdose_category) keys in sample_submission.csv.
completeness_constraints.scoring_subset_note: MAE scored only on overdose_category in {all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants}; CV must filter to these 3 categories to match leaderboard.

advisory_issues: Interaction features (gtrends_overdose_x_category_enc etc.) are not marked experimental — if target-enc leaks between interaction partners the Step-6A gate must catch this; programmer should treat interactions as experimental if target-enc is involved.

state_doh_release has 29.6% missing in train covariates and 32% in pred; empty-string imputation before TF-IDF is the safest fallback but may produce a sparse zero row — programmer should confirm this does not create an all-zero SVD component.
fixes_applied: Ensured all columns from all four file_schemas entries are covered (no uncovered_columns).
period_id mapped to key + datetime_derived (ordinal rank + seasonal) — never raw string.
Lag and rolling-std features: rolling-std flagged experimental; target lags unsupported by <3x lag well-satisfied (min_len=77 >= 36=3x12).
image_sidecars block added for mat_density sidecar with colormap inversion plan.
submission_frame_expansion derived from file_schemas n_rows, not hardcoded.

plan_warnings: unemployment_rate (54.6% missing) and labor_force (58% missing) in pred frame — jurisdiction-level imputation is the only safe strategy; if jurisdiction has no training data for these covariates, global median fallback is required.
gtrends_fentanyl and gtrends_naloxone show distribution shift; lag/diff features reduce but do not eliminate this risk.
sample_submission.csv shows 918 rows = 6 periods x 51 x 3 but val/covariates.csv has 7 pred periods — programmer must join on sample_submission keys, not all covariates rows.
Sub-target categories (benzodiazepine etc.) are absent from prediction frame and sample_submission; they are auxiliary lag/aggregate sources only, not direct model targets.
